sections.label: Smart Financial Centre vision
sections.summary: In 2015, MAS laid out a vision for a Smart Financial Centre where innovation is pervasive and technology widely used.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: In 2015, MAS laid out a vision for a Smart Financial Centre, where innovation is pervasive and technology is widely used.

sections.label: MAS fintech initiatives and labs
sections.summary: MAS issued cloud guidelines, introduced a regulatory sandbox, staged the world's largest Fintech Festival, and over 20 global financial institutions set up innovation labs here.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: For example, last year, MAS issued new guidelines on the use of cloud computing services by financial institutions to give them confidence to adopt new fintech solutions hosted on the cloud.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: MAS has also introduced a regulatory sandbox for financial institutions and fintech players to experiment with new technologies while limiting the potential consequences of product failure.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Last year, Singapore staged the world's largest Fintech Festival.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Today, more than 20 global financial institutions have set up innovation labs or research centres here, specialising in areas, such as data science, machine learning, user experience and design thinking.

sections.label: Financial sector training programmes
sections.summary: The Financial Information Technology Academy and IBF offer digital transformation and new learning modules, with MAS funding through training schemes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The Financial Information Technology Academy has developed a digital transformation programme for mid-career professionals that includes topics, such as data analytics and agile development.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The Institute of Banking and Finance (IBF) will also be offering new learning modules on data science, human-centric design, agile thinking and cybersecurity awareness.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Through the Financial Training Scheme and IBF Standards Training Scheme, MAS provides funding to support professionals in acquiring specific expertise and competencies in the financial sector.
